nl.title: Uitleg over de DirectAdmin Filemanager
nl.excerpt: Navigeer, upload en bewerk bestanden met de DirectAdmin File Manager.
nl.bodyHtml:
File Manager bewerkt bestanden op de server zonder FTP-client — handig voor snelle fixes.

Voorbereiding

  • Juiste domein
  • Begrip van public_html

Stappen

  1. System Info & Files → File Manager
  2. Open domains/jouwdomein/public_html
  3. Upload/extract/zip naar behoefte
  4. Bewerk bestanden via Edit
  5. Controleer permissies indien gevraagd

Controleren

  • Site laadt na wijziging
  • Geen permissiefouten

Tip: Maak een kopie van kritieke bestanden vóór edit.

Let op: Verwijder nooit lomp hele public_html zonder backup.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

en.title: Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager
en.excerpt: Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager: what it is, where to manage it at TripleZero iT (DirectAdmin), and what to watch for.
en.bodyHtml:
Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager comes up often with hosting, DNS, email or your control panel. Below is what it means and how you use it in practice at TripleZero iT.

You usually manage this via DirectAdmin. Always select the correct domain or account before changing anything.

In short

  • Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager matters when you change configuration, availability or security of your services.
  • Wrong assumptions lead to wrong fixes: first confirm DNS, panel and application belong to the same domain.
  • Note your current setup (product, domain, panel) so the guidance matches your situation.

Where to manage it

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin.
  2. Select the domain or subscription that “Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager” applies to.
  3. Open the matching section (DNS, email, files, SSL, applications or account).
  4. Only change what you understand; take a backup before risky steps.

Practical points

  • Change one critical setting at a time so you can see cause and effect.
  • Always test outside the panel (browser, mail client or DNS lookup).
  • If you are unsure about impact on mail, SEO or checkout: read related articles or open a ticket.

Tip: Summarise in one sentence what “Guide about the DirectAdmin Filemanager” means for your project before you change anything.

Note: Do not reuse passwords across services. Enable 2FA wherever available.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Also browse other knowledge-base articles on hosting, email and security.
